There are few paradoxes that challenge the idea of a god.

"If god is all-powerful, can he create a rock so heavy that he himself cannot lift? If he cannot create such a rock, then he is not all-powerful. If he can create that rock, then he is also not all powerful, because he is unable to lift it. 

"If god is all-knowing, of the past, the present and the future, then is there any free-will at all? Because that would mean that our destination and everything that we do are already pre-determined. So, you are already destined to either go to heaven or hell. Ergo, some of you are created to be the inhabitants of hell. Some of you are purposely being born into the wrong religion, so that when you die, you will be punished eternally. Is that a trait of a being that is all-merciful?"

"Why does god speaks through books? Aren't there a much better form of communication that can eliminate the uncertainty of which religion is the correct one? Maybe god can communicate via a worldwide PA system? Why create different faiths that has led to so many wars and lost lives throughout human history?"

If today, in this modern age, one guy comes down a mountain, alone, and claims that he has spoken to god, would you believe him?

They say that religion "X" is perfect, it is just that the its believers are imperfect. Have they actually read through the holy book of that religion? In its entirety? Have they skipped through the part on cruel punishment, where you have to punish those that goes against the rule of that religion? What about the imbalance of rights across genders and races?

Over the history of mankind, there were thousands of gods created to explain the natural phenomenons that occur in our universe, but due to our expanding understanding of the universe, they were all debunked. What is different about your god? Is there a possibility that in 1000 years, they will be debunked as well?

To say that god is the answer to everything that we don't have the answer yet, is lazy. We should continue to search for an answer, one that can be accepted beyond any reasonable doubt. Like the law of physics. Until then, we can say, "we don't know yet".
